title: Addon Source Catalog And Marketplace
problem: Nako now has a completed read-only addon source catalog / marketplace discovery boundary for listing the built-in official source, browsing installable metadata, and resolving an AddonInstallDescriptor without hidden registration, package signing, provider breadth, rollback/update execution, task dispatch credentials, or process/container supervision.

evidence.summary: Lane opened after the Addon Manager lifecycle lane closed with a proven manager-owned registry/plan slot.
Reference study completed against Jellyfin plugin repositories, Home Assistant app repositories, Visual Studio Code extension manifests, and Obsidian plugin manifests/version gating.

Froze the lane around read-only source listing, browse metadata, and descriptor resolution while splitting package signing, provider breadth, rollback/update execution, authenticated outbound task credentials, official-addon task-path smoke, and process supervision.
Implemented Admin source catalog DTOs and routes for built-in official source listing, entry browsing, and install descriptor resolution with focused no-hidden-lifecycle-work tests.

Closed the lane as the final Addon core runtime and architecture mainline slice; final rerun passed fmt check, diff check, JSON parse, API contract route test, focused catalog discovery nextest, and the 62-test addon nextest gate. Remaining addon work is explicit product/ecosystem breadth.

continue_policy.notes: The Addon core runtime and architecture mainline is complete. Open separate follow-ons for package signing/trust roots, provider breadth, rollback/update execution, authenticated outbound task-dispatch credentials, official-addon task-path smoke, or direct process/container supervision.
